calls:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED Home composition and edit target. Make one separate EMPTY architectural room-shell layer from this exact image, at the same landscape aspect ratio and same camera, framing, stonework palette and timber geometry. Preserve the floor perspective, ceiling beams, timber wall columns and arched stone window frame in exactly their original positions.
REMOVE ALL movable content and reconstruct the walls/floor hidden behind it: the man, ring/posts/ropes/platform, punching bag/chains, dumbbells/rack, bench/towel/bottle, bed/chest/table/stool, shelves/books/trophies, all plants, banners, torches/lanterns/candles, rug. Remove every UI plaque, HUD, button, icon and every letter. No objects or furniture remain.
WINDOW: the inside of the large arch must be actual transparent alpha, not a checkerboard, not white, not the castle. Keep the stone surround and sill opaque. Only this window aperture is transparent; all wall/floor/ceiling pixels are opaque. We will put a separate exterior image behind this aperture in Unity.
Maintain warm baked ambient light and gently shaded walls/floor but do not leave prop-shaped shadows. Match the precise original perspective and pixel-art style, with crisp nearest-neighbor-like clusters. No redesign, zoom, alternative camera, new rooms or extra doors. This is a single empty architecture asset, not a screenshot of UI, not a grid or contact sheet.

Edit target: this empty pixel-art room shell. Make ONLY these fixes: remove the three remaining light fixtures completely (the left wall torch and its bracket, the large hanging lantern and chain near x=580, and the lantern right of the window near x=1170). Reconstruct the wood/stone hidden behind them. Keep existing warm ambient lighting, architecture, window position, floor, dimensions and perspective exactly unchanged. The window aperture must have clean real transparent alpha with neutral edges: eliminate the stray red/orange fringe and isolated pixels inside the transparent hole, preserving the opaque stone arch and sill. No other objects, furniture, characters, UI or text. Output one 1672x941 RGBA room-shell layer.

Background extraction edit. Input 1 is the final room architecture; input 2 has the desired ACTUAL ALPHA window shape. Remove only the fake white-and-gray checkerboard from the window of input 1 and replace it with REAL transparent pixels (alpha 0), exactly as the alpha hole in input 2. Output RGBA PNG with actual alpha. Do not DRAW a transparency checkerboard or paint a white/black rectangle. Do not copy the lanterns/torch from input 2. Preserve all opaque architecture from input 1 unchanged. A clean transparent hole fills the arch interior; keep the rim and sill opaque. No UI, words, furniture, light fixtures or characters.

Input image is a reference for the view through its arched window. Render ONE independent rectangular exterior artwork asset only: the same moonlit blue fantasy castle atop the steep rocky hill, glowing warm small windows, tiny waterfall, stone bridge from the left, layered blue mountains and starry indigo sky, bright full moon upper right. Reconstruct a complete unobstructed view with extra bleed around all sides so it can sit behind a separate arched window in a game. Preserve the original pixel-art style, castle design, palette and relative scale. Portrait landscape illustration 2:3 aspect ratio, single image. No room architecture, no window frame, no objects inside the room, no plants in foreground, no characters, no UI, no text. The castle peak below the moon; sky in top third. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur.
